# crosswork_alarm_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the cleanup options and the trap and syslog processing of alarms and events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_alarm_settings" "example" {
  security_device_alarms_cleared_days     = 31
  non_security_device_alarms_cleared_days = 8
  all_events_days                         = 31
  device_alarms_days                      = 61
  system_alarms_days                      = 62
  network_alarms_days                     = 63
  audit_logs_days                         = 31
  trap_processing                         = false
  syslog_processing                       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all_events_days` (Number) Days after which all events are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `30`
- `audit_logs_days` (Number) Days after which audit logs are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `30`
- `device_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all device alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `60`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `network_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all network alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `60`
- `non_security_device_alarms_cleared_days` (Number) Days after which cleared non-security device alarms are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `7`
- `security_device_alarms_cleared_days` (Number) Days after which cleared security device alarms are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `30`
- `syslog_processing` (Boolean) Process the syslog messages of the devices
  - Default value: `true`
- `system_alarms_days` (Number) Days after which all system alarms, active and cleared, are deleted
  - Range: `7`-`365`
  - Default value: `60`
- `trap_processing` (Boolean) Process the traps of the devices
  - Default value: `true`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_alarm_settings.example "alarm_settings"
```
